noneNames: No strain in the catalogue names {label}.
mentions: strains name {label} in seed bank texts or database entries. Mentions are not amounts and apply to the respective source, not to every batch.
topProducts: Product names with the highest median ({label}, at least 20 samples)
casFirst: First of {n} numbers listed at PubChem (isomers/mixtures)
noOwn: No own strains or lab reports with {name}.
basis: Basis: {n} strains with terpene mentions in seed bank texts (CI-Strains-Pro) plus approved database entries. Collective names such as “pinene” are not assigned to an isomer.
wheelAria: Terpene wheel: assignment of terpenes to aroma families
serverOnly: The local strain catalogue is only available with a TERPGRID server.
notInSources: Occurrence in cannabis not documented in the reviewed sources. Listed because seed bank or database texts name it.
structure: 2D structure according to PubChem · without stereo wedges
entryNote: The title shows whether a specific stereoisomer is meant.
inCatalogSub: Mentions in seed bank texts and database entries – not amounts
perSample: Measurements apply to the respective sample and are never transferred to the catalogue.
smellKeywords: Keywords according to the reviews listed below.
noSmellPubchem: PubChem contains no odour description; the atlas does not add one.
occurrenceSub: Only sources whose full text was reviewed
notInChecked: Not documented in the reviewed sources.
noHealth: The presence of a terpene in a strain says nothing about health or psychoactive effects.
withMentionSub: Without isomer information in seed bank texts or database entries
subtitle: occurrence in cannabis is documented with literature. No promises of effects.
wheelSub: Documented odour descriptions by aroma family
dashed: Dashed dots: no documented odour description. Families are a rough classification of the original descriptions.
noHitsText: Reset filters or try another spelling.
systematicsSub: Backbone (isoprene units) and functional group – according to the PubChem molecular formula
compareSub: Up to three compounds side by side
catMentionsSub: How many strains name a terpene – not concentrations
measuredSub: Only from your own lab reports – per sample
noQuantText: Proportions are only shown from lab reports with measurements. Catalogue data contains no amounts.
samplesNote: Values apply to the measured samples of retail products with the same name without a breeder – not to a specific strain or plant. Source: {citation} Licence {license}.
intro: {n} compounds with chemical identity from PubChem (retrieved on {date}), 2D structure and documented odour descriptions. For {lit} of them,
